title: PCSO Lotto Results: Megalotto 6/45 bettor bags P44-M jackpot
summary: One bettor won the Megalotto 6/45 jackpot in Friday night's draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.

blocks.text: One bettor won the Megalotto 6/45 jackpot in Friday night's draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.
The bettor, who bought the ticket in Bulacan, correctly guessed the combination 33-37-36-26-23-03 to win the P44,198,060.38 jackpot.
No player hit the P603.58-million jackpot in the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw. —VBL, GMA News
